verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that anyone can publish and consume providers, modules, and policies on the public Terraform Registry. Terraform also documents creating reusable configurations with modules, and its MCP server draws module data from that registry. A community complaint about module ergonomics does not contradict registry consume/publish capability. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the module publishing workflow (versioning and source requirements), independent hands-on corroboration of consuming or publishing registry modules.
